The sectors we raise capital for

Zambia's next decade will be built on power, metal and food.

Each of these sectors has capital looking for it. Few of its projects arrive ready. That gap is where we work.

Energy and power

Hydropower, solar and power for mining, in a country short of generation.

Mining and critical minerals

Copper, cobalt and the licences behind them, from exploration to processing.

Agriculture

Aggregation, storage and agro-processing across the value chain.

Land and infrastructure

Logistics, storage and the corridors that move goods to market.

Why it matters

Our standards

Zambia does not lack projects. It lacks projects prepared for capital.

Demand is rising

  • Power for mines, cities and industry
  • Copper and cobalt for the energy transition
  • Food security across the region

Capital is selective

  • Ownership that cannot be shown on paper
  • No feasibility study or valuation
  • No one to carry the process to a decision

How we hold ourselves

Contact

Capital follows trust. Trust follows standards.

Due diligence

  • Title, licences and ownership verified before any introduction
  • Feasibility and independent valuation required
  • Financial statements or a model behind every number

Integrity

  • Know-your-customer checks on every counterparty
  • No upfront fees. Success based, agreed in writing
  • We never hold investor funds

Commodities

  • Seller licences and export permits verified first
  • Payment only after independent verification at destination
  • Responsible sourcing in line with OECD due diligence guidance

Project owners

Have a project ready for capital? Send the documents and we will tell you where it stands.
